description: Returns a list of daily reports

dateFrom.description: Daily report with report date on or after the date specified. Date format yyyy-mm-dd

dateTo.description: Daily report with report date on or before the date specified. Date format yyyy-mm-dd

house.description: Daily report relating to the House specified. Defaults to Bicameral

skip.description: Number of records to skip, default is 0

take.description: Number of records to take, default is 20

name: list_daily_reports
title: list_daily_reports
